source: Latest integrated cards 4 and 5 supplied by the requester on 2026-10-29
known_gaps_observed: Remote public.work_cases has no requester_name column.
accept_and_delete_work_case and extraction transaction/job RPCs below are not deployed.

Unregistered sender: quote_versions requires supplier_id. DB owner must support unlinked request evidence without inserting a synthetic supplier. No backend workaround or supplier insert is permitted.

all_mutations.authorization: service_role only, user ID from server-verified JWT; every case/mail/supplier reference must match the owner
all_mutations.atomicity: Each mutation RPC runs on one database connection and one transaction. Never implement by sequencing independent REST mutations.

errors.code: RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND | WORK_ALREADY_STARTED | REVISION_CONFLICT | ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED | REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS | IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED

case_extraction_health.requires: Only ready after the columns, all RPCs, durable jobs, atomic deletion/receipt semantics and unregistered-sender storage are deployed and verified.

transaction: begin_api_request for POST /api/v1/work-cases/{canonical UUID}/accept-increase; replay is checked BEFORE case lookup
lock owner case, require Waiting/PENDING_START with no decision and matching input_revision; reject Running before any deletion
Keep provider-key receipts for ALL removed mail messages, outcome ACCEPTED and mail_id NULL, with no subject/body/attachment metadata; foreign-owner rows must never be touched
Delete the owned case, associated mail_messages and case-specific logs/runs/drafts/jobs after checking all FK constraints; do not delete suppliers or shared histories
complete_api_request with the entire immutable 200 response in the SAME transaction; keep api_requests even though the case is gone
accept_and_delete_work_case.receipt_requirement: Initial sync, history reset and repeated push must all honor ACCEPTED provider-key receipts and never recreate a deleted request. No Gmail delete call.

transaction: begin_api_request for POST /api/v1/work-cases/{canonical UUID}/start; replay before state guards
lock owned case and verify Waiting/PENDING_START, not archived/accepted, revision; otherwise appropriate ERROR
start_review, status Running, processing_step EXTRACTING, current_batch_id, INFO_EXTRACTOR run and short workflow log
Create ONE durable extraction job keyed by owner/case/batch, containing owner, revision, first mail and run IDs; no mail body/token in job
complete_api_request stores the entire 202 response atomically; 202 only after durable job commit

claim_case_extraction.returns: null or {job_id, claim_token, owner_user_id, case_id, input_revision, batch_id, mail_ids}
claim_case_extraction.requires: Atomic durable claim (SKIP LOCKED or equivalent); only one unexpired owner per job; lease >= 60 seconds, heartbeat renews it. Claims do not reexecute expired jobs.

heartbeat_case_extraction.requires: Renew only a live owned lease whose case/batch/revision remains valid.

args.p_result: ExtractionResult JSON or null for HOLD

transaction: Lock job and case; verify live lease, owner, Running/EXTRACTING, no archive, batch and current input_revision. If obsolete, mark only the old run/job STALE and return STALE without writing case/quotes.
Revalidate source-mail ownership, evidence IDs, decimal/date values and allowed fields. No client/LLM-supplied owner, run IDs or supplier IDs.
Match sender email to same-owner REGISTERED/VERIFIED_WEB supplier; on exactly one match link mail_messages.supplier_id. Ambiguous matches must not be chosen arbitrarily. Do not INSERT suppliers.

Persist immutable quote_versions with source_mail_id/evidence and old/new price references, or the DB-reviewed unlinked-request representation for unknown suppliers. Do not fabricate a supplier FK or return synthetic quote IDs.

Save work_cases.requester_name/item_name/standardized_item_key/specification/unit/quantity; keep status Running. STORED+item null => NEEDS_INFO, STORED+item present => SELECTING_CANDIDATES, HOLD => ON_HOLD.
Save agent_runs structured output, current revisions, source refs and short workflow_logs; finish the durable job atomically. Never store private model reasoning or raw provider credentials.

fail_case_extraction.requires: Owned matching job only. On matching case/batch/revision retain Running and set FAILED + short error_jsonb, failed agent run/log. On changed revision/batch mark old run STALE, never overwrite newer case state. Duplicate finalization is harmless. Never Complete.

recover_case_extractions.requires: Fail only expired PROCESSING leases as WORKER_INTERRUPTED; preserve pending durable jobs, other live workers and newer case batches. Never reset/reexecute an expired job automatically.
